scope: Actual Anthropic request structure in characters, not tokens or causal cost attribution

selection.meaning: Post-termination descriptive paired prefix only; NOT the planned full12 or R7-12 window.

arithmetic.identity: requestRatio * meanInputRatio = inputRatio; descriptive identity, not a causal decomposition

limitations: No tokenizer allocation is inferred from character lengths.
Business-generated histories and fixed platform instructions both vary.
This analysis does not subtract random model decisions, retries or tool failures from consumed tokens.

condensedFrom.transformation: Per-request rows omitted, aggregate fields retained; per-request hashes remain in independent reports
